name: Legal & Contracts Pack
description: Commercial contract redlining, agreement milestone abstraction, and vendor privacy/compliance auditing for business teams.

agents.name: Contract Redliner
agents.description: Analyzes commercial contracts, NDAs, and MSAs against corporate playbooks to identify liability traps, IP assignment risks, and termination clauses.

agents.name: Agreement Abstractor
agents.description: Extracts renewal deadlines, payment milestones, SLA commitments, and notice requirements from agreements into structured summary tables.

agents.name: Compliance & Privacy Checker
agents.description: Audits vendor agreements and data processing addendums (DPAs) against GDPR, CCPA, and SOC2 requirements to verify standard privacy clauses.
